technology_type.evidence: inferred: For #717, the peptides were reconstituted in 0.1% formic acid and 10% of total digest was loaded on the Evotip Pure™ (Evosep). Peptide mixtures were analyzed by nanoLC-MS/MS on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 Mass Spectrometer equipped with an Evosep One LC system. Peptides were separated using the pre-programmed gradient (Extended method, 88 min gradient) on an EV1137 (Evosep) column with an EV1086 (Evosep) emitter.
